# McGill University

> McGill University's library system provides comprehensive research resources, digital collections, and scholarly support for academic communities.

McGill University Libraries serves students, faculty, and researchers across multiple campuses in Montréal, Quebec. The library system offers access to extensive print and digital collections, research databases, and specialized services including interlibrary loan and open-access publishing support.
